Visitor handles custom elements with nested content

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        class _TestVisitor implements HtmlVisitor {
            @Override public VisitResult visitCustomElement(NodeContext ctx, String tagName, String html) {
                return new VisitResult.Custom("[CUSTOM WIDGET]");
            }
        }
        var visitor = new _TestVisitor();
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<div><custom-widget data-value=\"123\"><p>Widget content here</p><span>With nested elements</span></custom-widget></div>", ConversionOptions.builder().withVisitor(visitor).build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
